title: Check active dwell events in SSMS via LocationActiveDwellModel (dwell tracking true/false per station)
summary: Use SSMS to verify which stations/locations are currently accumulating dwell time by checking the robot location database model’s DwellTracking (true/false) flag and then inspecting the LocationActiveDwellModel table for active dwell rows. Active dwell events should appear with timing fields such as SatTime, FinishTime, and TotalTime, and completed dwell should be archived to LocationDwellActivity after the AGV leaves.
when_to_use: When you need to determine which dwell-tracked stations/locations currently have active dwell events and to interpret the active dwell timing fields shown in LocationActiveDwellModel.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for investigating physical safety stops (E-stop). This procedure is limited to database dwell tracking visibility and timing fields.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the SSMS database checks for DwellTracking configuration and active dwell rows in LocationActiveDwellModel.
access_or_tools_needed: Robot location database model (with DwellTracking true/false field)
LocationDwellActivity table (for understanding that completed dwell is archived)

access_required: SSMS access to the OptiSweep/WCS database that contains the robot location database model and dwell tracking tables
system_preconditions: Dwell tracking is configured per station via the robot location database model’s DwellTracking true/false field

visual_references.description: Slide/frame showing LocationActiveDwellModel displays active dwells at locations marked for DwellTracking (true/false) and lists fields including AgvName, Station, SortGuid, SatTime, FinishTime, TotalTime; also notes archiving to LocationDwellActivity once the AGV leaves.

steps.title: Open LocationActiveDwellModel and confirm it shows active dwells for DwellTracking=true locations
steps.purpose: Verify that dwell tracking configuration is producing active dwell records in the active dwell table.
steps.instruction: Open the LocationActiveDwellModel table and confirm it is displaying active dwells at locations marked for DwellTracking.
steps.expected_result: LocationActiveDwellModel contains active dwell rows corresponding to stations/locations where DwellTracking is true.
steps.healthy_condition: Active dwell rows are visible in LocationActiveDwellModel for the dwell-tracked stations/locations you identified.

actions.exact_action: Open the LocationActiveDwellModel table and confirm it is displaying active dwells at locations marked for DwellTracking.

If the expected tables/fields (LocationActiveDwellModel) are not present or cannot be found, stop and escalate to L3_support/vendor support for database access/schema clarification.

steps.title: Confirm the dwell event is represented as an active record (current in LocationActiveDwellModel vs archived)
steps.purpose: Ensure you are looking at the current dwell event state (active) rather than only historical/archived dwell activity.
steps.instruction: For the active dwell rows you are investigating, confirm the dwell event is currently represented in LocationActiveDwellModel (active) rather than only archived.
steps.expected_result: The dwell event you are investigating appears in LocationActiveDwellModel as an active record.

steps.failure_condition: The dwell event is not present in LocationActiveDwellModel (suggesting it may have already been archived).

success_criteria: You identify stations/locations with DwellTracking set to true in the robot location database model.
LocationActiveDwellModel shows active dwell rows for those DwellTracking=true stations/locations.
Active dwell rows display the expected fields: AgvName, Station, SortGuid, SatTime, FinishTime, TotalTime.
healthy_conditions: LocationActiveDwellModel contains active dwell rows for dwell-tracked locations (DwellTracking=true).
Timing fields (SatTime, FinishTime, TotalTime) are populated for active dwell rows.
Completed dwell events are no longer present as active rows and are instead archived to LocationDwellActivity after the AGV leaves.
failure_conditions: No active dwell rows appear in LocationActiveDwellModel for stations/locations expected to be dwell-tracked.
DwellTracking true/false field is missing or cannot be found in the robot location database model.
LocationActiveDwellModel or the expected columns (AgvName, Station, SortGuid, SatTime, FinishTime, TotalTime) are missing or cannot be found.
escalation_guidance: If LocationActiveDwellModel shows no active dwell rows for stations you expect to be dwell-tracked, re-check the robot location database model’s DwellTracking true/false setting for those stations.

If the expected tables/fields (LocationActiveDwellModel and the listed columns, or the DwellTracking field) are not present or cannot be found, stop and escalate to L3_support/vendor support for database access/schema clarification.
